data.camera: medium shot, sitting on a wooden fence with village children
data.description: 【希斯特里亚 · 村落走访】墙内村落的晒谷场边，希斯特里亚穿着便装与农家的孩子一起坐在木栏上，白色连衣裙的裙摆沾着草屑，她笑眼弯弯——「女王也是从小在孤儿院听着你们的笑声长大的呀。」
data.promptProse: Historia sits on the wooden fence beside the village grain-drying yard with farm children, smiling warmly in a plain white dress with grass caught at its hem. The medium view includes the children near her knees and the open yard stretching beyond the fence. Village daylight illuminates their faces and worn fence grain, with soft rail shadows across the dress and small ground shadows beneath the seated group.
data.title: 希斯特里亚 · 村落走访
